summary: Americas CarMart Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board retained Houlihan Lokey as financial advisor to evaluate strategic alternatives, including financing, recapitalization, M&A, and other transactions. A Special Committee was established, and Adam Paul was appointed as independent director and Special Committee Chair. No specific terms (price, stake, premium) were disclosed. The filing signals an open-ended strategic review; Houlihan Lokey will explore options. No board recommendation or advisor fees were stated. Monitor for announcement of a definitive agreement or range of alternatives; the absence of deadlines suggests a deliberate process with uncertain outcome.
